collection_scope: Only listed modules, collect-only on original and target under same locked env and original pytest plugins. No tests execute during collection.
mapping_rule: Require complete original module marker count equal collected node count, and exact original/target node identity and order per interpreter. Refuse mismatches; map only F positions. Union F nodes across interpreters without inferring passes from dots.
execution_rule: Each selected node executes once, on Python 3.12 when it failed there, otherwise on a Python version that emitted its F; explicit fixed-case assignments override. No entire module execution.
